well_summary: The PRAIRIE FALCON CARSLAND 7-14-18-25W4 well was spud on June 02, 2026 at 07:15 hours and reached a total depth of 1145.00m on June 05, 2026 at 11:05 hours. The well is a vertical well and targeted the VIKING SS.

The drilling contractor was Trinidad Drilling Ltd. and Horizon Directional provided directional services. Geological supervision was provided by Melissa Chan, P.Geo and Trevor Wong B.Sc on behalf of Chinook Consulting Services.

The well was drilled from surface location 7-14-018-25W4. Surface coordinates were 150.0m North of South, 200.0m West of East boundary of section 7-18-25W4, situated at a ground level elevation of 812.40m (Reference: Sea Level). Bottomhole coordinates were 150.0m North of South, 200.0m West of East boundary of section 7-18-25W4 at a true vertical depth (TVD) of 1139.00m from kelly bushing (817.90m). Total depth was reached at 1145.0m, in the MANNVILLE.
A total of 4 drilling bits were used to drill the well, with a cumulative drill time of 8.25 hours, resulting in an average penetration rate of 138.8m/hr.

Total gas was monitored using a Pason gas detector. Drill cutting samples were collected over the interval 700m-1145m, 5m intervals, 1 set for Prairie Falcon Resources Inc. and 1000 to 1145m, 5m intervals, 2 sets for the SEM.
Wireline logs were run by Halliburton. MWD Gamma was recorded.

formation_evaluation: Objectives: The primary objective of the PRAIRIE FALCON CARSLAND 7-14-18-25W4 well was the VIKING SS Formation.

It was encountered at a measured depth of 1034.23m (True Vertical Depth 1028.99m, Subsea -211.09m). MWD Gamma confirmed the top of the formation at measured depth of 1034.23m (True Vertical Depth 1028.99m, Subsea -211.09m).
The PRAIRIE FALCON CARSLAND 7-14-18-25W4 well was completed as a cased vertical VIKING SS crude oil production well.

daily.operations_summary: Move rig on location. Rig up. Pick up BHA at 16:30hrs Spud well at 17:00 and Drill 222mm hole from 4.5m to 99.0m at 19:37hrs. Condition and circulate. Back ream to run casing. Laydown directional tools at 22:15hrs. Rig to and run casing at 23:45hrs. Condition and circulate.
daily.tag: Jun 02: drilled to 128m in 1.5 hrs, ROP 85m/hr

daily.operations_summary: Rig in cementers and cement casing. Plug down at 01:21hrs. Wait on cement. Cut casing and weld bowl. Nipple up BOP's. Rig up flare and degasser lines. Pressure test at 07:15hrs.  Make up directional tools and BHA. Trip in the hole at 10:45hs. Drill out cement, float and shoe at 11:00hrs.  Drill ahead 159mm vertical hole to 804mMD reached at 23:15. Reem back to the shoe, TIH to bottom, condition and circulate, TOOH.
daily.tag: Jun 03: drilled to 1037m in 4.5 hrs, ROP 202m/hr

daily.operations_summary: Continue to trip out of the hole. Layout directional tools 07:00hrs. Pick up core barrel, make up bit. Slip and cut. Trip in the hole to Core Point of 804mMD. Circulate, drop ball. Core from 804m to 816mMD at 12:26hrs to 16:17hrs. Pull out of the hole with Core #1. Handle and process Core #1. Reload core barrel / inspect bit and run in for Core #2. Cut Core # 2. Core from 816 to 828mMD from 18:00hrs to 22:45hrs, Pull out of the hole.
daily.tag: Jun 04: drilled to 1068m in 1.5 hrs, ROP 21m/hr

daily.operations_summary: Trip out with Core #2. Handle Core #2 at 02:15hrs. Pick up directional tools at 03:45hrs. Trip in the hole to 804mMD and log to 828mMD. Drill ahead to Total Depth of 888mMD at 07:39hrs. Condition and circulate. Back ream to core point. Pull out of the hole. Laydown directional tools at 12:00hrs. Rig up wireliners at 13:00hrs and log well. Rig out wireliner. Rig to and run casing 18:45. Condition and circulate. Rig in cementers. Cement.
daily.tag: Jun 05: drilled to 1145m in 0.8 hrs, ROP 103m/hr

daily.operations_summary: Continue cementing. Plug down at 01:42hrs. Nipple down BOP's. Rig out flare and degasser lines. Lower mast. tear down rig for location move. Rig release at 04:00hrs.
